scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Now Basta is in charge of refinement for shadow items.
If you'd like to refine a shadow item, please visit him.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
現在巴斯塔負責暗影裝備的精煉。
如果您想精煉暗影裝備，請去找他。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Do you want to refine a shadow item? Pick yer poison!
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
你想精煉暗影裝備嗎？選個礦石吧！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
When a shadow item is refined, it gains extra bonuses very much like normal items.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
當暗影裝備被精煉時，它會獲得額外的加成，非常類似於普通裝備。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Weapon: ATK, MATK + 1 increase for each +1 refine success.
Etc: HP + 10 increase for each +1 refine success.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
武器：每次精煉成功+1，攻擊力和魔法攻擊力各+1。
其他：每次精煉成功+1，HP+10。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
All types of Oridecon and Elunium can be used to refine shadow items. Each attempt will also cost 20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
所有種類的神之金屬和鋁都可以用來精煉暗影裝備。每次嘗試還需要支付20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
HD ores can be used for gear that is at least refine level +7 and will prevent breaking as long as you stay talking to me.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
HD礦石可用於精煉等級+7及以上的裝備，只要您一直和我對話，就能防止裝備損壞。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
There's nothing here!
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
這裡什麼都沒有！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
I require {0} zeny as a fee for EACH refine attempt.
Choose your Ore and start refining.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
每次精煉嘗試都需要收取{0} Zeny的費用。
請選擇礦石並開始精煉。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
HD Ore can only used for +7 or higher refine level items.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
HD礦石只能用於精煉等級+7或更高的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
You've cancelled refining.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
您已取消精煉。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
You do not have enough {0}.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
您的{0}不足。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
You do not have enough zeny.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
您的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Shadow Equipment can be refined to the maximum of 10...
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
暗影裝備最高可以精煉到+10...

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
This item cannot be refined.
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
該物品無法精煉。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
The safety refine level for Shadow Equipment is +4.
Shadow equipment may be destroyed in subsequent refinements. Want to get started?
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
暗影裝備的安全精煉等級是+4。
後續的精煉可能會導致裝備損壞。要開始嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
The safety refine level for Shadow Equipment is +4.
The next refinement, if it fails, will degrade the refinement. Do you want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
暗影裝備的安全精煉等級是+4。
下一次精煉如果失敗，精煉等級將會降低。您確定要精煉嗎？

scripts.text: Proceed
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Heh, I knew it!
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
嘿嘿，我就知道！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Well then.. here goes nothing!
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
那麼...祝好運！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
It worked! It worked!
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
成功了！成功了！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Oh Odin No!
scripts.translation:
[影子鐵匠]
奧丁啊！
